findings.title: Retry can accept a replaced required root as an empty sample
findings.observed: Owned child renames private TMP, removes the enumerated volatile child in the old root, creates a new same-UID empty TMP root. Actual stat fails ENOENT. Second attempt succeeds with a different root inode; budgets.complete=true, privateTmpNonprofileBytes=0; actual helper wait returns completed.
findings.remedy: Pin the first acquired root identity and ancestor route identities across every retry. Reacquire and compare them before accepting a replacement traversal; a missing or changed required anchor must refuse. Preserve ephemeral child churn and original partial evidence; do not use mutable mtime/size as the live anchor identity.
